'''Lures''' are a series of blocks introduced in [[Version 1.9.0A1]]. They're used to halt [[Evolution Phases|Evolution Phase]] Point gaining as well as reduce them through the use of [[Carcass|Carcasses]].

They're currently a Work In Progress.

== ''Usage'' ==
After placing one down, Players need to right click it with an empty hand. The Lure will disappear, and at its place, black particles will appear. Above the hotbar, the message "Point Cooldown added!" will appear.  Parasites will not be able to gain points until a certain time limit has elapsed, which can be seen under "Individual Halt Duration" in the table below.

Arranging five lures in 7x7 area with one in the middle and the rest in the corners will create a [[Carcass]]. Upon using the middle lure, a nondamaging lightning will strike and above the hotbar, the message "Points reduced!" will appear. Using a Carcass will spawn a [[Scent System|Scent]].  Parasites will then lose a certain number of points, which can be seen under "Carcass Point Reduction" in the table below. Carcasses cannot be used during [[Evolution Phases|Evolution]] cooldown.

==''Carcass''==
[[File:Carcass Arrangement.png|thumb|256x256px|Carcass (Concrete blocks for scale)]]
Carcasses are multiblock structures composed of Lures that are created by the Player in order to reduce [[Evolution Phases|Evolution points.]]

The structure requires 5 Lure blocks. The Lures are arranged in a 7x7 square with one in the middle and the other 4 in the corners. Right clicking the middle Lure will activate the Carcass expending all 5 lures. Upon usage, all five of the Lure blocks will disappear and the message "Points Decreased!" will appear over the hotbar, with the relevant amount of evolution points being deducted from the current dimension's total. The amount of [[Evolution Phases|points]] subtracted from a Carcass is the same number as the seconds of point cooldown of the central Lure. Using a Carcass in survival mode will summon nondamaging lightning and a [[Scent System|Scent]] of a certain level, depending on the central Lure.
